headline: While Inflation Falls, Production Must Be Protected: ITO's Recipe for the New Medium-Term Program (OVP)
summary: ITO President Şekib Avdagiç called for selective financing mechanisms to protect production, exports and investment in the medium-term program expected in September. He proposed measures across five headings.
why: The Medium-Term Program sets Turkey's official economic targets, which guide investors' expectations on policy and inflation.
